title: Parallel Experimentation and Competitive Interference on Online Advertising Platforms
authors: Caio Waisman; Navdeep S. Sahni; Harikesh S. Nair; Xiliang Lin
eligible_reason: Bias from concurrent online experiments by competing advertisers; the package contains only simulation code. No DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: simulations.R (with pacotes.R, funcoes.R) simulates competing advertisers' parallel experiments; graph_generation.R plots the results.
data_files_note: No data files; all results are simulated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
